channel.description: Nature is the foremost international weekly scientific journal in the world and is the flagship journal for Nature Portfolio. It publishes the finest peer-reviewed research in all fields of science and technology on the basis of its originality, importance, interdisciplinary interest, timeliness, accessibility, elegance and surprising conclusions. Nature publishes landmark papers, award winning news, leading comment and expert opinion on important, topical scientific news and events that enable readers to share the latest discoveries in science and evolve the discussion amongst the global scientific community.

item.title: [6] Semiconductors pushed into insulator territory
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Hironori Okumura

Score 6/10 C_MAYBE

Why: Relevant material electronic properties with potential experimental implications.

Tags: #semiconductors #electronic-properties

Abstract: A material that was previously assumed to be an electrical insulator has been shown to be a semiconductor, with potential uses in electronics and optics.

item.title: [6] Experimental observation of critical topology
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Shuang Zhang, Jian-Hua Jiang

Authors: Zhi-Kang Lin, Li-Wei Wang, Ze-Lin Kong, et al.

Score 6/10 C_MAYBE

Why: Experimental investigation of topological states, relevant to broader topological interests.; tier capped to C: formal/generic theory watch

Tags: #topology #experiment

Abstract: Experimental evidence indicating that critical gapless topological states can be characterized by the entanglement spectrum and wavefunctions is presented, demonstrating persistence of topology at phase boundaries and extension to higher-dimensional systems.

item.title: [8] A chiral superlattice route to spin-split topological antiferromagnetism
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Philip Kim, Su-Yang Xu

Authors: Thao Dinh, Mengke Liu, Jian-Xiang Qiu, et al.

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Topological antiferromagnet with Berry curvature, relevant to user's magnetic topological materials interest.

Tags: #topology #antiferromagnet #Berry-curvature

Abstract: A chiral superlattice in collinear antiferromagnetic UOTe generates large Berry curvature and spin-polarized currents, enabling anomalous Hall effects and advancing chiral quantum materials for spintronics.

item.title: [6] Observation of critical topological phase transition
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Jiangbin Gong, Baile Zhang

Authors: Zheyu Cheng, Xiuhai Zhang, Xue-Jia Yu, Longwen Zhou, Jiangbin Gong, Baile Zhang

Score 6/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Experimental topological transition; relevant to topological material interests.

Tags: #topology #metamaterial

Abstract: Using an acoustic metamaterial platform, a critical topological phase transition is experimentally demonstrated establishing a hierarchical phase transition organization, in which topology shapes criticality beyond the conventional Landau–Ginzburg paradigm and standard topological phase transitions.
